Description - GET /Image.aspx

The client does not request this URL; it recognises web URLs on the chomikuj domain containing Image.aspx or ShowVideo.aspx?id= and converts them into chomik://files/… download entries. Live probe: GET http://chomikuj.pl/Image.aspx?id=<fileId> without any cookie 302-redirects straight to a signed file-server URL (anonymous access to an own PNG).

Security notes - findings that concern GET /Image.aspx

  • S-09 Info Image.aspx?id=<fileId> redirects anonymously to a signed URL (observed for an own PNG in a non-protected folder; file ids are sequential; protected folders untested).

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
